description: This file defines the Consume utility class which provides factory methods for creating Akka stream sinks that process messages wrapped in WithSender objects. It includes methods for creating sinks using consumers and bi-consumers, supporting different message types and types of processing. The class is designed to facilitate the consumption of messages with sender information within an Akka stream in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: Consume
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create Akka stream sinks from consumers or bi-consumers of WithSender messages.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a sink from a consumer of WithSender messages, accepting a consumer that processes messages wrapped with sender information.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a sink from a bi-consumer that processes message and sender separately.

methods.name: untyped
methods.description: Creates a sink from a consumer that handles all message types without specific type constraints.
